purpose: Materialize source-bound terrestrial nuclear-site aerial-event, aggregate and reporting-policy rows for later cross-domain comparison with the SPACE ledger. Event rows, aggregate rows and policy rows are deliberately not conflated.

representation_contract.target_invariant: source-bound terrestrial aerial-event/reporting structure near nuclear infrastructure
must_preserve: site/facility identity at the available precision
whether a row is an EVENT, AGGREGATE, POLICY_CHANGE or ARCHIVE_SERIES
must_not_infer: physical event rate from archive counts without denominator
cross-domain identity before an independent SPACE witness survives its own controls

rows.source_authority: U.S. Department of Energy / NNSA release

reported_features.reported_size_one_account: approximately 4 ft tall x 2 ft wide

rows.official_read: Unidentified slow-moving object; report did not establish unique propulsion or origin and described it as non-threatening.

rows.source_authority: U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission / NARA RG615
rows.reported_mirror_summary: NRC email chain concerning a distant initially described possible drone/UFO. Public mirror transcription says local police and a state-police helicopter did not identify the object; a weather balloon was considered; the event did not meet then-current security-incident reporting criteria and no SIDS report was made.
rows.bridge_blocker: Primary document bytes/text not yet bound; do not promote the mirror transcription to primary evidence.

rows.source_authority: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
rows.title: Records from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission Relating to Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena

rows.policy_fact: NRC states regulations were updated in 2024 to require nuclear power plant licensees to report drone sightings; reports are shared with NRC, FAA, FBI and local law enforcement.

rows.reported_scope: Los Alamos Conference on Aerial Phenomena; green-fireball observations and competing hypotheses were institutionally discussed.
rows.bridge_blocker: Exact event/conference dates and contemporaneous logs must be bound before day-level joins.

known_missingness: The three NARA NRC PDFs are series-bound but their primary bytes are not mirrored into this repository yet.
AARO FY2024/FY2025 public aggregate counts are not event-level tables and therefore cannot be exact-date joined.
Site-time exposure/reporting denominators are not yet complete.
No-record is not encoded as no-event.

Obtain event-level AARO/NRC rows where publicly available.
Build site-year reporting denominators before rate modeling.
